descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S10 Generate gate by pre-round state and context: nothing today / typed but not saved / saved

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). Yesterday's panels are never silently reused. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 8; TFA-94745 state 3; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af … (TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given The make-session Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, nothing typed today

When Per context: look at Generate before any pre-round; type into the pre-round box and close without Save Note; then Save Note

Then After a successful Save Generate Note & Finish is enabled (asserted). Rows 'nothing today' and 'typed but not saved' are recorded the same way, with no assertion, until Q2 says whether 'disabled until Save succeeds' also covers them (main: enabled with nothing today, disabled with a 'tap Save Note' reason when typed but not saved). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs on the Encounter tab snapshot: after Save (cp3/cp6) the Generate Note & Finish button does not carry [disabled]. cp1/cp2/cp4/cp5 are evidence for Q2 only: no assertion on the button in either the literal reading or main's extra PR #53 rule, so neither row is judged by what main happens to do. The U6 failed-state evidence is S11, S12 and S26

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
